connector.name: Phasefolio
connector.registryDescription: Biotech rNPV/PoS engine for AI agents. Signed exports, evidence register, asset landscape.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.phasefolio.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.phasefolio, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional bearer token (Bearer pft_...) for org-scoped tools. Public tools work without auth.

env.name: PHASEFOLIO_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for org-scoped tools. Without it, only the 3 public tools are usable.
